therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of menstrual bleeding and fibroid-related symptoms
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: number of participants with amenorrhea during the last 28 days of treatment period 1

biomarker_changes: endometrial thickness reduction: -2.2 to -1.3 mm during treatment phase
endometrial thickness reduction: -3.1 to -0.5 mm during follow-up phase
subgroup_findings: HMB response achieved in 17-20 participants in vilaprisan groups vs 8 in placebo group during treatment period 1
median time to amenorrhea onset: 3-9 days in vilaprisan groups
median time to controlled bleeding onset: 1 day in most vilaprisan groups
results.dose_information: 2 mg once daily up to 2 x 12 weeks

context.duration: up to 2 x 12 weeks treatment periods with follow-up up to approximately 2 years
